newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Northwest Air to list in three yrs -- paper.
newsitem.headline: China Northwest Air to list in three yrs -- paper.

text.p: China Northwest Airlines plans to float its shares on a foreign stock exchange in three years, the South China Morning Post reported on Thursday.
The Chinese carrier, one of the nation's big six airlines, is seeking foreign investment to help it stem losses, it said.

The daily quoted airline president Nie Shengli as saying China Northwest would be restructured into a shareholding company to acccept Chinese and foreign shareholders before seeking an overseas listing in 1998 or 1999.
Nie declined to give any loss figures but said he would turn the carrier around in two years, the daily said.
China Northwest Airlines operates about 100 domestic routes and four foreign routes to two Japanese cities and Hong Kong and Macau, it added.
